decision: The competitor (Haas F1 Team) is fined €1,000.
event_name: Haas F1 Team Document 42 Date 24 June 2018 Time 15:42 2018 FRENCH GRAND PRIX 21 - 24 June 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 22.10 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
